rules.soldier: 24starting choices. Serialized effects +50Damage,+50AttackSpeed are plain permanent stats, not conditional. +10Speed,+200PickupRange,+15Knockback. Native weapon.should_shoot checks parent.current_movement==ZERO or can_attack_while_moving; no removal of flat stats. Correct previous compiler approximation which moved them into stationaryStats. Existing outgoing projectiles/reload continue while new attacks are blocked; movement intent includes pushing a wall. Saved Danger2win unlock. Unit._physics_process stores get_movement before collision resolution; PlayerMovementBehavior returns analog/button input. Therefore pushing a wall still counts as moving for the attack gate.
rules.speedy: 21choices. +30Speed,+1Melee per2currentSpeed with truncation toward zero,-3Armor and extra-100Armor while stationary. Temporary Speed counts for conversion and reverses on removal. Personal50Speed unlock, persists when Speed falls.
rules.vagabond: 29choices. Every physical weapon counts for the set bonuses actually present on carried weapons; no phantom classes. No duplicate equipped families; same-tier shop merge remains allowed. -5Armor,-5Dodge,Luck/Harvesting gains x.5. Native experimentation checks6distinct simultaneous weapon_id hashes, not total6copies. New counts.distinctWeapons uses canonical equipped weapon ids, no new remote. Native ItemService removes lower-than-owned tiers and equal maximum-tier copies from the regular AND backup pool. Same-tier upgradable copies stay eligible for merging; higher tiers stay eligible. Shop pool now applies this native no-duplicate filter.
rules.king: 42tierII choices. +50Luck; per tierIV weapon +25Damage/+25AttackSpeed, per tierI weapon -15Damage/-15AttackSpeed. Per different tierIV item +5MaxHP; per different tierI item -2MaxHP; duplicate copies of same item count once. Native bourgeoisie counts3simultaneously equipped tierIV+weapon copies, including duplicate family; does not count items. New counts.tier4Weapons uses Config.Player.maxWeaponTier in current4tiermodel.
rules.loud: 38choices. +30Damage,+50Enemies,per successful wave -3Harvesting before harvesting payout and native growth. Example10Harvesting ->7paid ->8aftergrowth; next wave5paid ->6aftergrowth. Failed-wave retry does not pay/apply another wave-end loss. Personal5000lifetime enemy kills unlock.
